dialogues.speaker: Ironbelly
dialogues.text: The guests are really getting into it. It's very exciting!

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: I've been found out. Small wonder you're the boss!

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: I've actually been an extra in quite a few films. One time, I was playing a Fortress of Meropide Guard who took a well-placed knee from a protagonist...

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: My friends and family all said it was my best work — a career highlight! My image has been inextricably tied to this guard costume ever since.

choices.text: I hope we get more reviews like yours.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: Just look at all the thrilling mechanisms in this attraction! If we could only add a spooky maze, it would be so much more immersive!

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: But it's important to look out for children and those with heart conditions, so I understand why we can't.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: *sigh* What if I were to open up a separate... "Ghost House" type attraction?

choices.text: Don't get too carried away on the job.

response.speaker: Ironbelly
response.text: Don't worry about me. I won't let myself get careless.
